articles.summary: GLENS FALLS, N.Y. (July 24, 2025) – Arrow Financial Corporation (NasdaqGS® – AROW) ("Arrow" or "the Company") announced financial results for the three-month period ended June 30, 2025. Reported net income for the second quarter of 2025 was $10.8 million and fully diluted earnings per share ("EPS") was $0.65, versus net income of $6.3 million and EPS of $0.38 for the first quarter of 2025.
